age_estimator_notes.fay: gravity-viscous spreading of 93.5 m3 reaches at most 0.880 km2 even at the 72 h ceiling, but the observed slick is 2.64 km2 -- 3x larger. Fay cannot account for this area at any age we model, so there is no Fay age to report. The area is set by shear and advection, which is independent evidence that the shear estimator is modelling the right process.
age_estimator_notes.mixture: discharge_class was 'unknown' (elongation 3.77 falls between the acute and chronic bands). Of the two hypotheses, only the moving-source track one moved the prior enough to call a measurement (0.041 nats vs 0.004 for the patch hypothesis), so it alone is reported.

model_mix.weighting: equal per model: no ground truth for origin position exists on any case, so any skill weighting would be invented
